title: What Senolytic Anti-Aging Therapeutics Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Senolytics are drugs that selectively destroy senescent 'zombie' cells — aged cells that stop dividing but refuse to die, secreting inflammation that drives aging and disease. Clearing them rejuvenated tissues in animals and showed promise in early human trials. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Senolytic Anti-Aging Therapeutics: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Senolytic Anti-Aging Therapeutics in one line: Senolytics are drugs that selectively destroy senescent 'zombie' cells — aged cells that stop dividing but refuse to die, secreting inflammation that drives aging and disease.
Why it matters: Removing zombie cells treats aging itself, not just its diseases..
Where it is used: frailty, osteoarthritis, pulmonary fibrosis, diabetic kidney disease, aging..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.
